name: biff-code-quality
description: >-

---

Run the `biff-code-review` skill and address any findings. Repeat until there
are no more findings. Don't just report findings to the user; you must fix them,
even if the change required is large.

If this skill was invoked manually, review uncommitted changes. If there are no
uncommitted changes, review differences from the current branch and the commit
from the main/master branch that this branch is based on. If we're on the
main/master branch, ask the user what they want you to review.

At the end, run `clojure -M:run code-quality` and ensure it passes. Do not relax
constraints in the clj-kondo / cljfmt config like max line length; just fix the
the code to meet the current constraints.
